mcpServers._tomaco-mcp-server-comment: OPTIONAL, disabled by default — live component/prop/CSS-class validation for tomaco-components (14 tools: get_component_info, validate_props, get_utility_classes, get_theming_info, get_changelog, etc.). Maintained by the Tomaco design-system team, not by Homero — ask them whether it's deployed for your org before enabling it. To enable: rename the sibling key below from 'tomaco-mcp-server-disabled' to 'tomaco-mcp-server' and set a real NPM_REGISTRY_TOKEN (not needed if tomaco-components is already installed locally). See references/css-utilities.md in the tomaco-design-system skill for what it adds over the static reference, and the skill's 'Tomaco MCP (optional)' note for how agents should use it once enabled.
